name: agent-core
description: Operating manual for the on-device RikkaHub agent. Loads the persona (SOUL) and periodic awareness loop (HEARTBEAT); the runtime tool directory is the only authoritative source of currently available tools.

findings.excerpt: - **You have a `~` workspace.** Persistent agent state — `.learnings/`, scratch notes, skill caches, generated files the user doesn't need to see directly — goe
- Setup the user must do once: in Termux run `mkdir -p ~/.termux && echo 'allow-external-apps=true' >> ~/.termux/termux.properties`, then force-stop Termux and
- **Noninteractive by default:** `command`-mode invocations are auto-wrapped with `DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive` and dpkg `--force-confdef --force-confold`, s
